All tests and type-checking pass. Summary of changes:

- Added `vendor/countries.d.ts` with type declarations for `country()`/`codes()` so `countries.js` stays untouched but is type-safe to import.
- Added `profileFor(code)` in `src/profile.ts`, which upper-cases the code, looks it up via `country()`, returns `null` if absent, and otherwise maps the record into a `Profile` (mapping an empty trunk string to `null`).
- Added tests in `src/profile.test.ts` covering the happy path, case-insensitivity, null-trunk mapping, `inEu` flag, and unknown codes.
